niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers compact, utility-focused interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, clear emphasis on the primary action, and minimal decorative clutter. They favor centered elevated modal cards over edge-anchored sheets, darker or dimmed backgrounds that focus attention, crisp structured controls, concise text, and vivid high-contrast accents. They also prefer explicit interaction affordances, visible content previews, and cleaner layouts with fewer unnecessary elements.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers compact, information-dense, well-organized layouts with less empty space and clearer grouping rather than airy or spread-out compositions.
Prefers bold headlines, clear sectioning, balanced text sizing, and obvious grouping of content and controls.
Prefers cleaner compositions with fewer decorative icons or extra interface elements, emphasizing utility over ornament.
Prefers vivid, high-contrast accent colors and strongly emphasized primary buttons over muted or weakly differentiated actions.
Prefers centered floating modal cards with soft elevation and a dimmed background that isolates the dialog and focuses attention.
Prefers direct-manipulation previews and clearer, crisper control styling that makes interaction possibilities more obvious.
Prefers dark or muted background treatments behind primary content rather than bright or washed-out backdrops.
